title: Thermal noise of a slab with held faces: mean-temperature PSD (thermal_noise study, analytic)
description:
thermal_noise study of heat alone: a silica-like slab of thickness Lx between two faces held at T0 (temperature on x_lo / x_hi; y faces insulated, so 1D), thermorefractive_noise with an expression weighting w = 1 / (Lx Ly L) on every cell, axial wavenumber 0 and a uniform axial profile of length L: X is the volume-mean temperature fluctuation in K, S its one-sided PSD in K^2/Hz.
Analytic (fluctuation-dissipation, (j omega C - k d^2/dx^2) u = w with u = 0 on the held faces): b = sqrt(pi f C / k), S(f) = 4 k_B T0^2 (sinh(b Lx) - sin(b Lx)) / (Lx^2 Ly L 2 pi f C b (cosh(b Lx) + cos(b Lx))), C = rho cp; flat below the first relaxation rate D pi^2 / (2 pi Lx^2) ~ 13 kHz at k_B T0^2 Lx / (3 k Ly L), f^(-3/2) above; variance k_B T0^2 / (C Lx Ly L). The uniform profile gives S = L S_2D(q0 = 0), the long-L limit (see the axial_profile help).
Derived values tab: S_low (largest psd, at 100 Hz), S_1e3 / S_1e5 / S_1e6 (psd at those frequencies, all solved samples) and X_variance (the result's variance: exact sum rule, float32 material and area rounding only). The cell-centred operator raises the high-frequency boundary-layer term by about (b dx)^2 / 4: ~4e-4 at 1 MHz, ~4e-3 at 10 MHz, < 1e-4 below 100 kHz.
Curves & tables tab: psd_slab (dashed analytic on series psd, judged against its low-frequency plateau). Derived curves tab: psd_ratio (psd / analytic over the whole band, dotted reference 1: the per-frequency check of the f^(-3/2) tail).

parameters.name: T_ref
parameters.description: uniform temperature T0 in K (noise scales with T0^2)

parameters.name: C_vol
parameters.description: volumetric heat capacity rho cp in J/(m^3 K)

parameters.name: L_x
parameters.description: slab thickness between the held faces

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (500 cells across the slab)

parameters.name: L_y
parameters.description: slab height (2 cells, insulated y faces: 1D)

parameters.name: L_int
parameters.description: interaction length L of the uniform axial profile

parameters.name: w0
parameters.description: weighting 1 / volume in 1/(K m^3): X = mean temperature fluctuation

parameters.name: S_pref
parameters.description: prefactor 4 k_B T0^2 / (Lx^2 Ly L) of S(f)

parameters.name: S_LF
parameters.description: low-frequency plateau of S in K^2/Hz (for reading the plot)

parameters.name: b_low
parameters.description: b = sqrt(pi f C / k) at f_low in 1/m
